gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-heebo: Heebo stands tall and tidy, its curves stopping short of closing. Funnel Display above it is all same-width rods, and that wiry, unwavering line is what this pairing does best.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-guntur: Rope-like strokes that never swell or thin give Funnel Display its look. Hind Guntur follows in a sans with the same cable-steady line, only taller and more gapped at the curves.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads friendly and easy, its s curves flung wide and its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Funnel Display brings the swagger; the sans body brings the welcome.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-mysuru: Wiry, bold and unshakeable up top. Hind Mysuru then settles into lowercase that presses toward the ascender line, with open-mouthed a shapes that keep a long page moving without calligraphic fuss.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-siliguri: Commanding in its heading, Funnel Display draws one unwavering line like bent wire and never lets a stroke thicken. Hind Siliguri works the other way, humming along in a gentle gray texture with rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-vadodara: Wiry letters, expressive and sure of themselves. Hind Vadodara supplies the quiet counterweight, a plain sans with big open e and a shapes, while Funnel Display carries the drama in its rod-like strokes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and brisk, with lowercase bodies rising near cap height and s terminals held clear of the stem. Try it a touch larger than usual.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight brings lines like bent tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back. Funnel Display runs the same tubing look at display size, and its commanding presence gives the sans body something to follow.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-karla: Karla reads stocky and friendly, with a gaping c and a tall middle band. Funnel Display's rod-built letters lead the page, and the sans below it settles in right behind them.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-kedebideri: Laser-cut wire up top, soft and open below. Shrink Funnel Display too far and its single-width rods lose their command, while Kedebideri, a plain sans with a skyward x-height, holds up even when large.
